calculator_engine: function overlap2(fund1,fund2){const set1=new Set(fund1.split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toUpperCase()));const set2=new Set(fund2.split(',').map(s=>s.trim().toUpperCase()));const common=[...set1].filter(s=>set2.has(s));const unique=new Set([...set1,...set2]);const pct=(common.length/unique.size)*100;return{overlap:pct.toFixed(1),common:common.length,total:unique.size};}
